name: 儿童动物帽透明帽檐雨衣款
description: 动物造型帽+透明大帽檐儿童雨衣，五色可选，上学雨天外穿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and macro, sunny yellow #FFD338 accents, soft cream #FAF3E0 and pale sky panels for scene and trust shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, gentle directional window light for scene shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep, light wood floor and matte panel boards
styleLock.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, friendly but not cartoonish
styleLock.iconSystem: thin rounded line icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: hooded poncho shown upright with hood shaped, stable slight 3/4 hero angle across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids rainwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sunny yellow #FFD338, sky blue #3FA9F5, cherry pink #F5A7C0, charcoal text #333333 and clean white #FFFFFF fields; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; thin rounded line icon style; clean high-key product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright hooded-poncho presentation with hood shaped and visible; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的合规主图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a child-size hooded poncho raincoat. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model, no visible face, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 双童模橙/黄主推+细节条（拉链/口袋/图案）；屏2 细节五宫格（防水拉链/翻盖口袋/印花贴布/按扣/动物帽）+黄衣背影；屏3 面料褶皱大图+粉色书包位侧身；屏4 按扣特写+尺码表（M-XXL，衣长68-96cm，适合身高80-150）+五色模特图（黄/黄拼桔/粉/蓝/桔）；屏5 蓝色透明大帽檐+按扣微距；屏6 黄色防水拉链+蓝色收口袖口；屏7 翻盖口袋贴布+动物帽平铺；屏8 双层面料+黄衣正背模特；屏9-13 黄/蓝/黄拼桔/粉/桔五色轮流正背展示+帽檐特写。品类判定：产品为儿童外穿连帽斗篷雨衣（成衣形态、雨天上学场景、尺码按身高段80-150），属外穿童装而非贴身睡衣家居，故判 母婴/童装 而非 内衣家居服/儿童内衣。13屏收敛为11镜：合并五色重复模特展示为1镜VARIANT、合并重复细节图为3镜DETAIL、纯重复装饰屏舍弃。已剥离：童模全部面容（仅保留背影与颈部以下裁切）、衣身具体卡通熊印花与贴布图文（仅保留矩形图位结构）、胸前盾形与贴布上的原品牌字样、英文口号字样、尺码表实测数值（原表自报数值不搬运）、材质成分文案（涤纶+PU涂层等原文表述不搬运，以视觉水珠呈现）、按扣与拉链上的品牌刻字。
